regions.region: full-page Organic Chemistry Frontiers accepted-manuscript cover
regions.finding: Publisher cover and citation notice only. The decorative journal artwork is not a reaction scheme and no experiment record is created.

unresolved: No chemical experiment occurs on this page.

regions.region: page 2 title, author block, abstract, and ESI sentence
regions.finding: The actual title was read from the article heading. The paper mentions online ESI spectra, but the workspace SI association is unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 2 left-column introduction and prior-synthesis discussion
regions.finding: The 1972 Landor racemic route and low-ee asymmetric variant are explicitly prior work and are represented as one literature-example record, not current-paper experiments.
The upper aggregated route is prior literature; the lower 3+4⇒2⇒1 drawing is the authors' retrosynthetic analysis and is classified as a general scheme rather than an executed experiment.

The 20→21 reduction (98%, E/Z 96/4) and subsequent deprotection/oxidation introduce Scheme 2 on page 3. The statement about unsuccessful compounds 6–16 is retained as unresolved because details are only in unassociated SI.

unresolved: The SI-only failed attempts 6–16 cannot be separated into individual records from the available source.
The retrosynthetic arrows carry no experiment-specific conditions or yield.

regions.finding: Seven distinct steps 17→18→5→19→20→21→16→3 were inventoried; each arrow is a separate experiment and detailed pages 4–5 are merged into the same records. The image-only 11% NMR overoxidation product and 39% NMR starting-material recovery belong to 16→3.
Five route arrows were separated: 22→23, 23→24, oxygen-bag 24→25, air-bag 24→25, and 25→4. The oxygen and air procedures remain independent experiments.

All ten EATA optimization rows were retained independently with x/y/z equivalents, chiral prolinol identity, 0.02 mmol CuBr2, 0.8 mL dioxane, sealed-tube 130 °C/12 h conditions, separate NMR/isolated yields, and ee.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Scheme 4 and adjacent prose
regions.finding: The 1.16 mmol EATA scale-up (50%, 97% ee, E/Z 94/6), KOH hydrolysis (98%), and analytical TMSCHN2 re-methylation (96%, 97% ee) are three separate experiments. The scale-up is not merged with Table 1 entry 10.
Aggregate nine-step synthesis and functional-group-tolerance claims summarize existing records and do not create another experiment.

unresolved: Table 1 omits absolute substrate/chiral-amine charges, atmosphere, workup, product masses, and ee method.
Several Scheme 2/3 transition times and selectivity analytical bases are not reported.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left conclusions continuation and Experimental general information
regions.finding: Narrative conclusion and shared analytical/materials conventions were inspected; they do not define an independent reaction. (S)-27 is said to follow literature and no current preparation is created.

Exact charges, Ar atmosphere, −78 °C 25 min n-BuLi addition, two −78 °C holds, natural warming, 22 h room-temperature hold, workup, chromatography, 12.5673 g, and 93% were structured as ordered steps.
Li/ethylenediamine activation at 80 °C for 1.5 h, cooling, t-BuOK 30 min, 18 addition over 5 min, room-temperature 2 h hold, workup, 7.0109 g, and 83% were retained separately.
The 0 °C DHP/p-TsOH charging, warming to room temperature, 12 h hold, workup, 2.2915 g, and 91% were extracted with all printed reagent quantities.
The 19/THF charge starts the same experiment that continues on page 5; no duplicate record is created.

unresolved: Addition durations or warming times not printed by the source remain null/missing.
Spectroscopy supports labels but does not verify machine SMILES.
